title: Save foods to a file
instruction: Write a program that saves the list `["Pizza", "Tacos", "Sushi"]` to a file called `favorites.txt`, with one food per line.
solution_code:
foods = ["Pizza", "Tacos", "Sushi"]
with open("favorites.txt", "w") as f:
    for food in foods:
        f.write(food + "\n")

title: Append to a log file
instruction: Write a program that appends the current time (as a string like `"Checked: 12:30"`) to a file called `log.txt`. Run it twice — the file should have two lines.
solution_code:
import datetime
with open("log.txt", "a") as f:
    f.write(f"Checked: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%H:%M')}\n")
